Three.js r160

RASTHOR·IA vendors the minified Three.js r160 ES module build and transforms
only its final export list into window.THREE so the dice renderer can also run
when index.html is opened locally without an ES-module file:// CORS request.
No Three.js engine logic is otherwise modified.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
